assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Complete the journey and listen for the announcement or information under test.

title: Every tab is in the tab order
description: The alpha tab set gives each tab tabindex=0, so Tab moves through all three tabs before leaving the tab list. The recommended roving model keeps only the selected tab in the tab order.

relatedElements.note: The control uses roving tabindex and is removed from the tab order.

expectedBehaviour: A tab list uses roving tabindex so that Tab enters the tab list once and arrow keys move between tabs.
userImpact: Keyboard users need extra Tab presses and may not understand that the tabs form one composite widget.

wcag.note: The tabs are still operable with Tab and Enter. Roving tabindex is an authoring-practice pattern, not a separate WCAG failure.

detection.note: The extra tab stops are only apparent when tabbing through the page.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported in the default state; the control on the same page or path also passes.

manualTests: Tab through the page and count how many stops the tab list contains.

assertions: All three alpha tabs have tabindex=0.
tests: tests/subtle-widgets.spec.js: keeps every alpha tab in the tab order

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective journey or widget behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
